photos.c: FRONTISPIECE: (Ed. Lacey) Geoff North just gets home ahead of Blackheath's John Herring in the Sward invitation 2 miles. Time: 8:50.4. Report on P.9.
Photos (full page montage; captions on page 12)
TOP LEFT:Geoff North leads P. Mellor and E, Watt during the Civil Service '3' which he won in 13:59.8.

THE WINNING LONDON-BRIGHTON RELAY TEAM (Southern Event) ON THE SEA-FRONT WITH THE PRESIDENT AND THE "NEWS OF THE WORLD" TROPHY. REAR:(L.toR.) P. Newell, W.Kerr,Geoff.North,R.Linstead,The President, A.Fairclough,B.Sawyer,C. Dabbs. FRONT:(L.toR.)J.Thresher,Gerald North,L.O'Hara,A. Black. (C.W. Walker was not present).
Geoff North (10) leads Gowan (110), Presland (211) and Thresher (3) in the opening match at Wimbledon.
Gerry North and Alan Black lead Geoff North (1), O'Hara (5), Thorpe (18), Fairclough (16) and Dabbs (27) shortly after the start.

FRONTISPIECE(Photo:R.Linstead) Geoff. North, who has had such a fine track season, set a new Belgrave 2 miles record of 8:43.0 in the AAA v London University match at Motspur Park early this season. He is seen here leading Mick Gowan, another of the "Lauriston Cottage community".

John Thresher (10) and Geoff. North (9) in the muddy thick-of-it during the Fire Brigade '2' at White City on Sept. 18th. The six runners that surround them are Gibson, Tulloh, Jackson, Stewart, Johnston, and J. Cooke. Geoff. (8:51.0) won from Jackson with John 6th (8:55.4).
My picture shows Bill (far right) alongside Chris Steer, our President Bob Taylor, Trevor Hart and Alan Black; with the two Norths and Dabbs in the front row.
CENTRE: A confident team await the start. (L to R): Black,Merry,Geoff North Gerry North,Dear,Steer,Major and Dabbs.
FRONT COVER :Geoff North sets a Club '5¾' record before embarking on a season which gave him an Inter-Counties 3 miles record and an international vest against the U.S.S.R.

I ONLY HAVE EYES FOR YOU! (Photo:R.Linstead).Ron Clarke and Geoff North exchange looks just after the start of the 5000m invitation at Crystal Palace on June 22nd. Winner was Sawake (7) from Gamoudi (12) and Clarke (1). Geoff finished 9th in 13:54.6 (!) only 18.4 seconds behind the winner.

BACK COVER (Photo by Ed.Lacey)--Geoff North and Beevor(Herc/Wim) lead an impressive bunch early in the National Championships at Sutton Coldfield. Following up are Cox, Adcocks, Turner, Moxom, Ashton, D. Holt and Hogan.
A perfect 'change-over' and John Bicourt sets off to continue the good work done by our fastest man of the day - Geoff North.
GEOFF NORTH hands over to brother GERRY for the last stage of the Walton Relay.

THE WINNING "JOHNSTONE" TEAM (Photo:David Hart)
BACK ROW(l.to.r.):G.Biscoe(Manager),A.Fairclough(Reserve),R.Piotrowski,L.O'Hara,P.Morris, P.O'Connor.
FRONT ROW(l.to.r.):G.W.Dance,J.Thresher,Gerry North(Captain),Geoff North,T.Hart.
Note:L. Mann is absent--under escort back to the Palace!.

Dick Piotrowski and Gerry North (left) chase Geoff North during the '5¾'. Dick fell back at four miles leaving Gerry to finish second, 27 secs down on his brother.
Photo:Ron Linstead.
FRONT COVER: (Photo: Ron Linstead---JOHN BICOURT (89) and GEOFF NORTH (98), our second and third scorers in the 'National', stride out in the fifties of the thousand-strong field at Blackpool
GEOFF NORTH leads the Hogs Back field ahead of the Holt twins (97 & 96) and Joslyn (300) who filled the first three positions at the finish.
